Lower tail is still underwater and invisible.

Preserve original tail angle and silhouette; no person or hair visible.

Match the original sparse shape and exact visible green remnants; no complete tail, no person.

Preserve the compact upright silhouette and sparse trailing white/cyan water strokes. No human legs.
